message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Station name** | **Miami Intermodal Center – Amtrak Station** | | **Address** | 1st St & 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33101 | | **Transit lines** | Amtrak (Silver Service/Palmetto), Metrorail, Metrobus, and the Miami International Airport (via the MIA Mover) | | **Pet policy** | • Pets are allowed on Amtrak trains, but must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• Only one pet per passenger (unless you have a service animal).
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier while on the platform.
• No pets in the dining car or on the train’s observation cars.
• Check Amtrak’s “Pets on Amtrak” page for the latest rules and fees. | | **Station amenities for pets** | • Designated pet relief area near the entrance (outside the ticketing hall).
• Hand‑washing stations and trash receptacles for pet waste.
• Clear signage indicating pet‑friendly zones. | | **Contact** | Phone: (305) 555‑1234 (Station Information)
Website: [amtrak.com](https://www.amtrak.com) | | **Why it’s a good choice** | • Central location in downtown Miami, close to the airport and downtown attractions.
• Fully accessible, with elevators and ramps for strollers and pets in carriers.
• Staff are trained to assist travelers with pets. | **Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet** 1. **Book Early** – Reserve a pet carrier seat on your Amtrak train in advance. 2. **Pack Essentials** – Bring food, water, a leash, a small waste bag, and a familiar blanket or toy. 3. **Check the Weather** – Miami can be hot; keep your pet hydrated and avoid the midday sun. 4. **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station and find the pet relief area. If you need more detailed information (e.g., specific pet size limits, fees, or service‑animal accommodations), visit Amtrak’s official pet‑policy page or call the station directly. Happy travels!
